title: When the Hymn Sings
author: Lena Blackwood
blurb: Marguerite Thornbury, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the family out ahead of the count before the last resident signs the papers.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
